name: hamch-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for power users — deep analytics, workflow tools, and more

plugins.name: insightful
plugins.description: Generate a comprehensive HTML insights report from your ENTIRE Claude Code history — every session, every project, all time. The built-in /insights covers recent activity; Insightful covers everything.

plugins.name: beads
plugins.description: Live HTML dashboard for your beads issue tracker — auto-opens on session start and refreshes whenever bd commands run. Shows active project issues with tabbed views, full issue detail, and a paginated grid of all other projects. Configure your projects root via BEADS_CODE_DIR env var.

plugins.name: brainy
plugins.description: Brainy turns Claude Code into your second brain — setup wizard, PARA vault scaffolding, company knowledge base, project detection, and daily workflow skills.
